body: Po Nagar is the Cham complex on đồi Cù Lao, in Vĩnh Phước, about 2 km north of the centre. The address is Tháp Bà Ponagar, Hai Tháng Tư, and also 61 Đường 2/4. Đường 2/4 is Hai Tháng Tư. The hill is about 10–12 m, and also over 20 m. The site covers 17,683.6 m² and runs from the 8th to the 13th centuries.

The main tower is about 23 m. The south tower is about 18 m. The northwest tower is about 9 m. The southeast tower is about 7 to 7.1 m. The main tower dates to 813–817 and was repaired in the 11th century. The northwest tower dates to 817 and was repaired in the 13th century. The southeast tower dates to the 11th–12th centuries. The south tower dates to the 13th century.

The site is a national historical-cultural relic, and Decision 152/QĐ-TTg of 17 January 2025 ranks Tháp Bà Pô Nagar a special national relic. The annual festival falls on lunar 20–23 of month 3. In 2026 it runs 6–11 May, lunar 19–25, with free entry. The traditional rite on the 23rd is timed at 4:00–6:00 and at 6:00–8:00.

gettingThere: The towers are about 2 km north of the centre, on đồi Cù Lao in Vĩnh Phước. The address is Hai Tháng Tư, and also 61 Đường 2/4. Đường 2/4 is Hai Tháng Tư.

legs.heading: From Trần Phú
legs.body: About 2 km north, to the hill at the mouth of the Cái.

legs.heading: From the airport
legs.body: About 27 to 30 km from Cam Ranh, then 2 km north to the towers.

admissionNote: 22,000 VND a person a visit. Free entry from 6 to 11 May 2026. Phone 0899 789 815.
